/*
 * Synthetic fixture, written for copycheck's tests; it is NOT taken from any
 * real codec and is dedicated to the public domain (CC0-1.0). It has the
 * proportions of a real decoder routine: a table of band offsets, a window
 * table, and one function of about fifty lines with loops, escapes and state.
 */
#include <stdint.h>

#define MAX_BANDS 24

static const int band_edges[25] = {
    0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64,
    76, 88, 100, 116, 132, 152, 176, 204, 240, 280, 328, 384
};

static const float window_coef[20] = {
    0.0007f, 0.0029f, 0.0071f, 0.0138f, 0.0237f, 0.0371f, 0.0541f,
    0.0745f, 0.0977f, 0.1229f, 0.1495f, 0.1763f, 0.2026f, 0.2276f,
    0.2507f, 0.2713f, 0.2889f, 0.3031f, 0.3137f, 0.3204f
};

typedef struct DecCtx {
    int gain;
    int num_bands;
    int max_sfb;
    int reservoir;
    GetBitContext gb;
    int scale[MAX_BANDS];
    float spec[384];
    float prev[384];
} DecCtx;

static int decode_spectrum(DecCtx *ctx, int frame_len)
{
    int band, k, start, end, esc_bits, level;
    int sign, mag, total_bits = 0;
    float step, acc;

    if (frame_len > 384 || ctx->max_sfb > MAX_BANDS)
        return -1;
    for (band = 0; band < ctx->max_sfb; band++) {
        start = band_edges[band];
        end   = band_edges[band + 1];
        step  = ctx->scale[band] * 0.25f + ctx->gain;
        for (k = start; k < end; k++) {
            level = get_bits(&ctx->gb, 3);
            total_bits += 3;
            if (level == 7) {
                esc_bits = 4;
                while (get_bits1(&ctx->gb) && esc_bits < 12) {
                    esc_bits++;
                    total_bits++;
                }
                mag = (1 << esc_bits) + get_bits(&ctx->gb, esc_bits);
                total_bits += esc_bits + 1;
            } else {
                mag = level;
            }
            sign = 0;
            if (mag) {
                sign = get_bits1(&ctx->gb);
                total_bits++;
            }
            acc = mag * step;
            ctx->spec[k] = sign ? -acc : acc;
        }
    }
    for (k = 0; k < frame_len; k++) {
        float w = window_coef[k % 20];
        ctx->spec[k] = ctx->spec[k] * w + ctx->prev[k] * (1.0f - w);
        ctx->prev[k] = ctx->spec[k];
    }
    ctx->reservoir += total_bits;
    if (ctx->reservoir > 6144)
        ctx->reservoir = 6144;
    return total_bits;
}
